jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher CMS Experiment (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Postdoctoral Researcher CMS Experiment

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 5 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FHPO009/2026 | Deadline: 24.09.2026 | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The CMS DESY group is based in Hamburg and is one of the largest groups worldwide participating in the CMS Experiment at CERN. The successful candidate will join a newly established Helmholtz Investigator Group at DESY, working within the CMS Collaboration to study how top quarks interact with the heavy bosons (W, Z, and Higgs) at the highest energies reached at the LHC. Using the full CMS dataset, the project targets these interactions in the boosted regime and interprets the measurements in the framework of Effective Field Theory, searching for subtle deviations from the Standard Model that could point to new physics. The work combines advanced jet reconstruction and identification with modern machine-learning techniques, offering the opportunity to develop expertise at the interface of experimental data analysis and cutting-edge ML methods.

About your role:

- Develop and apply advanced jet reconstruction and machine-learning techniques for the identification of boosted top quarks and heavy bosons, forming the methodological foundation shared across the group's measurements.
- Take a leading role in the unfolding of the differential cross-section measurements and in the global Effective Field Theory interpretation combining them into constraints on top-boson couplings.
- Co-supervise the group's PhD students and help shape the strategic direction of the measurement methods and analysis setup, ensuring continuity and knowledge transfer across the staggered projects.
- Contribute to CMS service and object-performance tasks.
- Represent the group within the CMS Collaboration and at international conferences, with the possibility of regular short-term research stays at CERN.

About you:

- PhD in experimental particle physics, completed or nearing completion.
- Demonstrated experience with machine-learning methods in high-energy physics, ideally applied to jet or boosted-object reconstruction and identification.
- Experience with differential cross-section measurements and unfolding techniques; familiarity with Effective Field Theory interpretations is an advantage.
- Strong scientific programming skills (e.g. Python and C++) and experience with modern ML frameworks; knowledge of the CMS software environment is beneficial.
- Ability to work both independently and within a team, to support and mentor students, and to communicate results effectively in English.
- Experience in supervising students is a bonus.
- lnterest in outreach activities is advantageous.
- Experience with global fits is a plus.

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Dr. Anna Benecke, anna.benecke@desy.de.

Please arrange for three letters of reference to be sent to the DESY human resource department by using our online tool: Additional application documents (https://www.desy.de/career/additional_application_documents/index_eng.html)

We look forward to receiving your application (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates) via our application portal:

Apply now (https://www.desy.de/career/online_application/index_eng.html?p=18404:10:0&jobid=FHPO009/2026&P_LANG=en)

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://www.desy.de/career/working_at_desy/what_we_offer/diversity__inclusion/index_eng.html) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://www.desy.de/career/working_at_desy/what_we_offer/equal_opportunities/index_eng.html)  is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de) (https://sbv.desy.de/) .

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.

Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.

Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.

You will play a key role in advancing our data-driven investment processes by building robust data platforms, pipelines, and backend services in a modern, agile environment.

This role sits at the intersection of portfolio management, end-to-end quantitative system development, and IT. It is an exciting opportunity to take ownership from day one and contribute to a meaningful transformation of the investment management industry.

Technology is a critical differentiator in creating future-proof and competitive investment capabilities, and you will have the opportunity to shape solutions that make a real impact.

- Collaborate closely with senior PMs on portfolio construction, optimization, and rebalancing frameworks.
- Work closely with investment teams, analysts, and architects to translate business and data requirements into scalable solutions.
- Implement and enhance scalable, modular backtesting and simulation frameworks for multi-asset and derivative strategies, incorporating real-world implementation constraints.
- Bring research models into production-grade investment and risk systems.
- Design and maintain end-to-end applications (including data ingestion, signal creation, portfolio construction, risk analysis, and monitoring).
- Design and manage large-scale financial and alternative data pipelines, transforming raw data into high-quality, model-ready datasets for specific investment use cases.
- Build and maintain backend components and APIs that provide reliable access to data products and platform services.
- Contribute to technical design decisions for data-intensive systems, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and compliance.

What you bring

- 5+ years of experience in data engineering, backend engineering, quantitative development/research, and/or portfolio management.
- University degree in Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
- Good understanding of portfolio construction, preferably in a multi-asset context, core asset classes, and global markets.
- Good understanding of financial markets, futures (rates, equity indices, and commodities), and options (including delta, gamma, convexity, and implied volatility concepts).
- Knowledge of econometrics and statistical modeling.
- Hands-on experience in developing, deploying, and operating production-grade solutions in Python.
- Strong SQL and data modeling skills.
- Hands-on experience with data pipelines and data platforms.
- Familiarity with modern SDLC tools such as Git, GitHub/GitLab, and Jira; experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.
- Exposure to AI, GenAI, and ML-enabled solutions is an advantage.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to PMs and business requirements to engineering and platform teams.
- Strong written and spoken English skills.
- Agile mindset, collaborative working style, and a high level of ownership.
- Experience with AI and Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Data Integration, DevOps Technologies, Data Science.

What we offer

jobs.occupation: Postdoc (m/w/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Helmholtz-Zentrum HereonThe Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon conducts cutting-edge international research for a changing world: Around 1,000 employees contribute to the tackling of climate change, the sustainable use of the world's coastal systems and the resource-compatible enhancement of the quality of life. From fundamental research to practical applications, the interdisciplinary research spectrum covers a unique range.

Institute of Metallic Biomaterials
In the Institute of Metallic Biomaterials new titanium and magnesium based implant materials for regenerative medicine are developed, produced and characterized. Researchers investigate the factors influencing the process chain and properties. In addition, the interaction of material and tissue is studied in the laboratory and at the synchrotron.

Postdoctoral Researcher - Agentic Correlative Image Analysis for BlueMaterials

JobID: 1058 - 2026/MB 3
Location: Rostock
Application deadline: 23 September, 2026

Join the Cluster of Excellence "BlueMat: Water-Driven Materials" ( www.tuhh.de/bluemat ) and collaborate with a dynamic, interdisciplinary team that combines science, sustainability, and technology to create a better future. Help shape the next generation of sustainable materials inspired by nature's most powerful resource: water.

For the Institute of Metallic Biomaterials, Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon for as soon as possible, we are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher - Agentic Correlative Image Analysis for BlueMaterials. In principle, the full time position (39 h/week) is also sharable. The position is fixed-term until 31 August 2029 and located in Rostock.

Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. We would therefore strongly encourage qualified women to apply for the position.

The BlueMat project 'Agentic correlative image analysis for BlueMaterials', bridges the different imaging and characterization techniques developed within the cross-area imaging and gives support to all researchers in the cluster of excellence to retrieve the highest quality information from image data. The project focusses on implementing an agentic framework for automation of correlative imaging and the corresponding image analysis in particular. By implementing LLM-driven agents that plan the analysis workflow, call established image-analysis modules and judge their own output, you will streamline image processing efforts and enable the elucidation of specific mechanisms of water-material interactions.

design and implement the agentic framework including task planning, tool use and function calling, and self-evaluation loops that orchestrate existing image-analysis modules
build a natural-language interface so BlueMat researchers can run correlative analyses without writing code
automate including image registration and enabling automated extraction of morphological features (e.g., porosity, tortuosity, connectivity) and fluid flow characteristics from 2D and 3D images resulting from magnetic resonance, X-ray and electron images
integration of motion analysis and digital volume correlation
processing of images in preparation for image-based modelling
individual support for researchers across BlueMat in solving image analysis challenges, especially segmentation and quantitative extraction

PhD in computer science, physics, materials science, applied mathematics or a related field
experience in building LLM-based agent systems
strong background in image processing and analysis, including deep learning
experience with correlative imaging workflows and 2D/3D registration techniques
strong programming skills in Python and/or C/C++
ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment
excellent communication skills in English
proven project management skills are highly desirable
willingness to travel regularly between Rostock and Hamburg (DESY)
